axis.description: integer axis along which to accumulate. If ``x`` is one-dimensional, this argument is optional and defaults to zero. dtype: optional dtype of the output.
constraints: axis must satisfy -rank(x) <= axis < rank(x) if x is not one-dimensional

include_initial.description: if True, then include the initial value in the cumulative product. Default is False.

output.description: An array containing the accumulated values.

constraints: dtype must be a valid numpy dtype or left empty for default
